profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, trading under the ticker LUMN. Its SEC CIK number is 0000018926. The company describes itself as a provider of a global fiber network, secure networking, edge cloud, and AI-ready infrastructure for connecting people, data, and applications. It says it is the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy, with a fiber footprint that reduces latency for real-time performance.

On its website, Lumen presents customer examples including the New York Yankees, which it says use diverse 100G paths and automatic failover between Yankee Stadium and Tampa, and American Family Care, an urgent care provider scaling across 26 states. It also states that Prometheus Hyperscale anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady on a private, low-latency network designed for heavy AI workloads.

The company has 57 legal exposure matters in Louisiana.
